head: Woord
Voor
Voorbeeld
rows: who
mensen
The woman who lives next door is a doctor.
which
dingen en dieren
The book which I'm reading is great.
that
mensen en dingen (niet na een komma)
The man that called you is here. The car that I bought is red.
whose
bezit (van wie, waarvan)

blocks.title: die en dat = who, which of that
blocks.text: Het Nederlands kiest tussen die en dat op grond van het woord (de of het). Het Engels kiest op grond van mens of ding: de man die = the man who, het boek dat = the book which / that. En wat na een hele zin is which: Hij kwam te laat, wat me stoorde = He was late, which annoyed me.

head: Beperkend (geen komma's)
Uitbreidend (met komma's)
rows: My brother who lives in Spain is a chef. (ik heb meer broers)
My brother, who lives in Spain, is a chef. (ik heb één broer)
The students who studied passed. (alleen zij)
The students, who studied hard, all passed. (alle studenten)
that mag: The film that we saw was good.
that mag niet: The film, which we saw last week, was good.

blocks.title: Na een komma nooit that
blocks.text: In een uitbreidende bijzin (met komma's) gebruik je alleen who of which: Amsterdam, which is the capital, ..., nooit Amsterdam, that is the capital.
In een beperkende bijzin mag je who, which of that weglaten als het lijdend voorwerp is (er volgt een nieuw onderwerp). Dat doen Engelsen in spreektaal heel vaak.

head: Met
Zonder
rows: The book that I read was boring.
The book I read was boring.
The people who we met were nice.
The people we met were nice.
The man who lives here is old.
Niet weglaten: who is hier het onderwerp.

blocks.title: Het Nederlands laat nooit iets weg
blocks.text: Het boek dat ik las heeft altijd 'dat'. Engelsen zeggen meestal gewoon the book I read. Herken die zinnen als je leest: er lijkt een woord te ontbreken, maar dat klopt.

In gewoon Engels staat het voorzetsel aan het eind van de bijzin: the girl I was talking to, the house we live in, the music I listen to. In formeel Engels staat het vooraan, met whom of which: the person to whom I spoke.

blocks.title: what = the thing that
blocks.text: what betekent datgene wat: What I need is a holiday. I don't understand what you mean. Na een zelfstandig naamwoord kan het niet: the thing that I need, niet the thing what.

rows: The man which called you is here.
The man who called you is here.
Voor mensen: who.
My mother, that is a teacher, lives in Delft.
My mother, who is a teacher, lives in Delft.
Na een komma geen that.
He was late, what annoyed me.
He was late, which annoyed me.
Na een hele zin: which.
The girl who her father is a pilot.
The girl whose father is a pilot.
Bezit: whose.
That's the shop where I bought it there.
That's the shop where I bought it.
where vervangt al 'daar'.
Everything what he said was true.
Everything that he said was true.
Na everything: that.
The man lives here is old.
The man who lives here is old.
who als onderwerp mag niet weg.

blocks.text: Vul who, which, that, whose, where of what in. De antwoorden staan op de laatste pagina.

items.q: The doctor ______ treated me was very kind.
items.full: The doctor who treated me was very kind.

items.q: Is this the bus ______ goes to the airport?
items.full: Is this the bus which goes to the airport?

items.q: That's the man ______ car was stolen.
items.full: That's the man whose car was stolen.

items.q: This is the café ______ we first met.
items.full: This is the café where we first met.

items.q: London, ______ is the capital of the UK, is very expensive.
items.full: London, which is the capital of the UK, is very expensive.

items.q: She failed the exam, ______ surprised everyone.
items.full: She failed the exam, which surprised everyone.
I don't understand what you're saying.

items.q: My sister, ______ lives in Canada, is visiting us.
items.full: My sister, who lives in Canada, is visiting us.

items.q: The music I listen ______ is mostly jazz.
items.full: The music I listen to is mostly jazz.
All that you need is love.

items.q: The student ______ phone rang had to leave.
items.full: The student whose phone rang had to leave.

items.q: That was the year ______ I finished school.
items.full: That was the year when I finished school.

items.q: De vrouw die naast ons woont is arts.
items.a: The woman who lives next to us is a doctor.

items.q: Dit is het hotel waar we logeerden.
items.a: This is the hotel where we stayed.

items.q: Hij kwam te laat, wat me stoorde.
items.a: He was late, which annoyed me.

items.q: Het meisje met wie ik praatte is Spaans.
items.a: The girl I was talking to is Spanish.
